feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Clinical Practice Outcomes With Lecanemab for Alzheimer Disease.
drug.zh: 真实世界用lecanemab的早期AD患者中，ARIA发生率与严重不良事件及12个月认知变化如何。

drug.title: From Proof of Principle to Therapeutic Discipline: Strategies to Improve the Benefit/Risk Profile of Amyloid-Targeting Treatments for Alzheimer's Disease.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗已确立疾病修饰地位，但获益/风险比窄，需优化策略以提升临床净获益。

drug.title: Anti-Amyloid Antibodies in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease: An Umbrella Review.
drug.zh: Lecanemab与donanemab可延缓认知衰退并清除β淀粉样蛋白，但需警惕ARIA风险。

drug.title: APOE-stratified genome-wide association analyses provide insights into the genetic etiology of Alzheimers's disease.
drug.zh: 按APOE基因型分层全基因组关联分析，揭示AD遗传病因及ε4/ε2效应机制。

drug.title: The path to treating multiple-etiology dementia: Combining vascular risk control and disease-modifying neurodegenerative therapies.
drug.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the A
drug.zh: 多病因痴呆需血管危险控制与抗淀粉样蛋白等神经退行性疗法联合干预，而非单通路治疗。

drug.title: Baseline plasma C1q and C3 as potential biomarkers for lecanemab efficacy and ARIA risk in early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 基线血浆C1q和C3可预测早期阿尔茨海默病中lecanemab的疗效及ARIA风险。

drug.title: In brief: Subcutaneous lecanemab (Leqembi Iqlik) for initial treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
drug.journal: The Medical letter on drugs and therapeu
drug.zh: 皮下注射仑卡奈单抗获准用于阿尔茨海默病初始治疗，提供静脉给药外的便捷选择。

mech.title: Targeting glial PD-1/PD-L1 restores microglial homeostasis and reduces neuronal hyperactivity in an Alzheimer's disease model.
mech.zh: 阻断胶质PD-1/PD-L1可恢复AD小鼠小胶质细胞稳态并降低神经元过度活跃。

mech.title: A multimodal model for clinically defined MCI integrating plasma biomarkers and brain microstructural features: a dual-cohort external validation study.
mech.zh: 血浆p-tau217联合白质微结构特征可跨队列区分临床定义的MCI与正常认知。

mech.title: LncRNA Loc646329 modulates Alzheimer's disease-related phenotypes through the miR-150/WNT/β-catenin axis in cellular and APP/PS1 mouse models.
mech.zh: LncRNA Loc646329通过海绵吸附miR-150激活WNT/β-catenin通路，改善AD细胞与APP/PS1小鼠模型的病理表型。

mech.title: Microglial dectin-1/Clec7a in an alzheimer's disease model: a double-edged sword across the lifespan.
mech.zh: 小胶质细胞dectin-1在AD早期限斑块、晚期损认知，呈病程依赖性双刃剑效应。

mech.title: Exosomes in Alzheimer's Disease: From Pathological Mechanisms to Biomarker Potential and Therapeutic Applications.
mech.zh: 外泌体在阿尔茨海默病中既传播Aβ和tau病理、驱动神经炎症，又具血液标志物与治疗载体潜力。

mech.title: Bioinformatics-Driven Discovery of Aβ-Targeted Therapeutics and Diagnostic Biomarkers for Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: WGCNA与机器学习锁定NFKBIA为AD核心枢纽基因，并筛选出靶向Aβ通路的小分子候选药物。

mech.title: Amyloid-beta-targeting monoclonal antibodies in early Alzheimer's disease: a cochrane review summary and appraisal for the neurological community.
mech.zh: Cochrane将七种抗淀粉样蛋白抗体合并分析，认知获益微小且异质性被掩盖，不宜据此判断单药疗效。

mech.title: Rethinking tau-targeted therapy in Alzheimer's disease: Toward a dual biomarker strategy.
mech.zh: 可溶性p-tau下降未必反映tau靶向治疗获益，需结合p-tau262等特定位点与纤维缠结标志物双重评估。

dx.title: A multimodal model for clinically defined MCI integrating plasma biomarkers and brain microstructural features: a dual-cohort external validation study.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217联合白质微结构DTI特征可跨队列区分临床定义的MCI与正常认知。

dx.title: A scalable workflow using digital cognitive assessment and pTau217 for MCI detection.
dx.zh: 数字认知评估前置可将pTau217检测阳性率从30%提升至约60%，实现MCI高效分层筛查。

dx.title: Rethinking tau-targeted therapy in Alzheimer's disease: Toward a dual biomarker strategy.
dx.zh: 可溶性p-tau降低未必反映tau靶向治疗获益，需结合p-tau262等特定位点与神经纤维缠结负荷的双生物标志物策略评估。

dx.title: Validation of plasma core biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease: A multicenter study in usual practice conditions.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217及p-tau217/Aβ42在真实临床条件下诊断AD的效能最优，且受共病与用药干扰小。

dx.title: Enhancing Alzheimer's disease diagnosis in primary care through targeted screening of people at risk of developing dementia - study design and feasibility assessment of the PREDEM primary care study.
dx.zh: PREDEM初级保健研究证实，联合数字认知测试与血液标志物靶向筛查可提升基层早期AD检出可行性。

dx.title: Regional juxtacortical microstructural changes and gene expression provide insights into neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: AD患者近皮层自由水升高区域与特定基因表达及神经退行通路空间关联。

dx.title: Digital cognitive phenotyping enhances risk stratification in preclinical Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 数字认知表型可分四型，在淀粉样蛋白阳性者中识别出近远期认知衰退高风险亚群。

dx.title: Plasma Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein and Neurofilament Light Chain Concentrations Are Inversely Associated with Retinal Microvascular Perfusion and Vessel Density in Cognitively Normal Individuals with Familial or Genetic Risk Factors for Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 认知正常但具阿尔茨海默病家族或遗传风险者中，血浆GFAP与NfL越高，视网膜微血管灌注与血管密度越低。

prev.title: Development and External Validation of an Explainable Machine Learning Model to Identify Positive Dysphagia Screening Results in People with Dementia: A Multicenter Cross-Sectional Study.
prev.zh: 可解释机器学习模型能跨中心外部验证，仅用常规临床变量即可识别痴呆患者吞咽筛查阳性风险。

prev.title: What is new in delirium: A vascular etiology outlook.
prev.zh: 谵妄或非短暂神经元功能障碍，而是连接全身炎症、血脑屏障损伤与血管性认知障碍的急性神经血管表型。

prev.title: Alzheimer's disease detection from structural brain MRI using FFA U-Net segmentation and transfer learning.
prev.zh: FFA U-Net分割结合迁移学习可从结构MRI自动识别阿尔茨海默病，省去人工勾画。

prev.title: Mortality trends and influencing factors of mental disorders among urban and rural residents in China between 2009 and 2021: a longitudinal study with projections to 2030.
prev.zh: 2009-2021年中国城乡精神障碍死亡率呈上升趋势且农村高于城市，预测至2030年将持续增长。

prev.title: Impact of Changes in Physical Activity on Dementia Risk Among Cancer Survivors: A Nationwide Cohort Study Comparing Chemotherapy and Non-Chemotherapy Groups.
prev.zh: 癌症幸存者确诊后增加体力活动可降低痴呆风险，且该保护效应在化疗组与非化疗组中均存在。

prev.title: Divergent associations of estimated cardiorespiratory fitness with cognitive trajectories in Chinese and U.S. middle-aged and older adults: A descriptive cross-national comparison from CHARLS and HRS.
prev.zh: 中国中老年人预估心肺适能越高认知轨迹越好，但美国人群未见此关联。

prev.title: Joint Effect of Subjective Memory Impairment and Physical Inactivity on Cognitive Impairment: A 2-Year Follow-Up Study Among the Elderly in a Korean Population-Based Cohort Study.
prev.zh: 重度主观记忆障碍与缺乏运动对老年人认知障碍存在协同交互作用。

prev.title: β-Amyloid and Glutathione Dysregulation Cooperatively Drive Lipid Peroxidation and Ferroptosis in Neuron-Like Cells.
prev.zh: Aβ与谷胱甘肽耗竭协同驱动脂质过氧化和铁死亡，加剧AD神经元损伤。

intro.title: Unlocking the Potential of Isatin Scaffolds in Acetylcholinesterase Inhibition.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲一种叫靛红的小分子可能帮阿尔茨海默病等患者保住大脑里一种关键信号，普通人可把它当作未来新药的线索。

intro.title: A new era of genome-wide association studies in the field of Alzheimer's disease and overlapping co-pathologies: lessons learned from a neuropathology-centered approach.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是：科学家正用大脑尸检的病理结果来更准地找阿尔茨海默病的致病基因，帮普通人理解为什么新药和基因检测值得期待。

intro.title: Caenorhabditis elegans as a Model for Studying Nrf2/SKN-1 Activation in Alzheimer's Disease: Plant Bioactive Compounds and Therapeutic Translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述用线虫这种小虫子研究阿尔茨海默病里一个叫Nrf2的抗氧化开关，看看植物里的天然成分能不能激活它来护脑，帮普通人了解吃某些植物或许能防痴呆。

intro.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
intro.zh: 抽血就能提前挑出大脑里还没症状但已埋雷的人，帮新药试验少花钱、快找人，普通人将来或能更早验出风险。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆可能是一根藤上的两个瓜，护好血糖或许能帮大脑少受罪。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 治阿尔茨海默病的新药能清脑内淀粉样蛋白，但可能让脑血管出问题，这篇综述告诉普通人用药前要留意中风和脑出血风险。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用人的干细胞在培养皿里造出迷你脑免疫模型，帮我们搞懂大脑里的“保安”细胞怎么在老年痴呆中帮倒忙，为找新药铺路。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是抽血查阿尔茨海默病的新方法，比腰穿和脑扫描更便宜省事，帮普通人早发现早应对。
